generate_evaluation_manifest: generate an evaluation manifest TSV file from a speech synthesis generation output directory and audio manifest
create_eval_manifest_with_resynthesized_: create an evaluation manifest using resynthesized reference audio instead of the original audio files
build_eval_manifest_for_target_evaluatio: build an evaluation manifest that evaluates the reference audio instead of model predictions
run_eval_manifest_with_custom_vocoder: run the evaluation manifest generator with a custom vocoder name and sample rate
generate_manifest_with_custom_audio_form: generate an evaluation manifest using a custom audio format like mp3 instead of wav
